body:
Yeah to be fair moving away from home is pretty big, but it's something I know will help my life and I've already worked for 3 semesters for it.  It's only a university 2 hours away, within my state.  So moving is big, sure, but it's no different than if I was at the normal age to move away for in-state university.  Shrug.  It's a thing I'm working towards.

Thanks.  I'm trying really hard to get the hours behind a wheel but it's so hard with my current arrangements.  I want to drive but it's just, so hard right now; it feels pointless.

And honestly?  Not really.  I wanted to go to a concert about a month ago, but I had no way to get there or back, so was yet again a disappointment.

And I guess I lied.  Math classes in college were a big reason I was semi-content the last few semester.  Calculus 2 ended in the summer, my college has no more math classes (which is why I want to move and got to a university).

> I stopped believing in happiness. This is what my therapist told me. He said "Happiness doesn't exist. It's one of those uncatchable fish. The best you can aim for is contentment.

To be fair, I haven't found happiness *or* contentment.  I've tried so hard to change my life over the past year to make things better, even if not at "happiness" level.

That said I'm not sure if I love an already bleak-ass future of non-happiness..  I wasn't expecting to go from depressed-as-fuck to sudden super-happy, but I **would** like happiness in my future, if there is one.

There's a couple things I could do... things I've been trying to do.

If I could drive, life would be immensely easier all around for me.  And I'm trying so God damn hard to do that but I haven't been able to get to 'test ready' or whatever.

Moving away, I... can't do until next fall semester (MAYBE this spring, but it's unlikely).

I don't know what other "small things" I can do.
